label: Low price
gloss: the bar's low price

label: Bar low vs open
gloss: how far the bar's low has run below its own open, ((low − open) / open) × 100 — never positive

label: MACD histogram
gloss: MACD histogram — the 12/26 line minus its 9-period signal

signal.description: The signal line’s length: the EMA of the MACD or PPO line.

label: MACD line
gloss: MACD line — the 12-period EMA of close minus the 26-period EMA, in price units

signal.description: The signal line’s length: the EMA of the MACD or PPO line.

label: MACD signal
gloss: MACD signal — the 9-period EMA of the 12/26 MACD line

signal.description: The signal line’s length: the EMA of the MACD or PPO line.

label: Mark price
gloss: the perpetual mark price — live on display, the decided bar's market-stats sample under a decision — not a bar close

label: MA alignment
gloss: price stacked against EMA20 / SMA20 / SMA50

label: MFI (14)
gloss: 14-period money flow index (volume-weighted RSI, 0–100)

period.description: The indicator’s length: the bars its window reads.

label: Market · share above EMA 50
gloss: share of the scope's coins closing above their own EMA(50) (%), over the coins whose EMA has warmed — the persistent breadth state: it holds its reading for runs of bars where net breadth flips almost every bar, and its zone reads risk-off at 20 or below and risk-on at 80 or above

label: Market · mean change
gloss: mean close-change across the scope (%), signed

label: Market · mean PPO histogram
gloss: mean PPO histogram across the scope, signed

label: Market · dispersion
gloss: spread of close-change across the scope (%, standard deviation) — how much the field disagrees; low means the coins moved together and a cohort-wide read describes them, high means the mean hides a wide range and the field is moving further per bar

label: Market · down share
gloss: share of the scope's coins that closed down (%), over the universe it was measured across

label: Market · net breadth
gloss: net breadth — the up share minus the down share (%), signed; negative is a broadly red field

label: Market · momentum down share
gloss: share of the scope's coins carrying a negative PPO histogram (%), over the coins that have one

label: Market · net momentum breadth
gloss: net momentum breadth — the positive-histogram share minus the negative (%), signed; negative is a field losing momentum

label: Market · momentum up share
gloss: share of the scope's coins carrying a positive PPO histogram (%), over the coins that have one

label: Market · stretch
gloss: mean RSI(14) across the scope — how extended the field already is, and a slow-moving state rather than a reversal trigger: elevated readings have tended to persist and to run with the move, not against it; the reading is sharpest on the tight crypto cohorts, since averaging the whole tracked universe pulls it toward the midpoint

label: Market · universe
gloss: the number of the scope's coins the price shares were measured over — the base of every share, published beside it so the base stays visible

label: Market · up share
gloss: share of the scope's coins that closed up (%), over the universe it was measured across

label: Market · participation
gloss: mean relative volume across the scope, each coin against its own 20-bar baseline (1.0 = the field at its own normal, 2.0 = twice it) — how much of the field is actually participating; on the stock and commodity scopes it also reads whether the underlying cash session is open, since those perps trade when their underlying markets are shut

label: TPO point of control (UTC month)
gloss: the price bin holding the most time of the current UTC month, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one 5-bps grid anchored at the period's opening price — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the period's first 60 minutes and while any earlier day of the period has no stored profile; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO value-area high (UTC month)
gloss: the upper edge of the 70% value area of the current UTC month, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one 5-bps grid anchored at the period's opening price — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the period's first 60 minutes and while any earlier day of the period has no stored profile; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO value-area low (UTC month)
gloss: the lower edge of the 70% value area of the current UTC month, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one 5-bps grid anchored at the period's opening price — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the period's first 60 minutes and while any earlier day of the period has no stored profile; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: Naked POC above
gloss: the nearest point of control above the price that no later UTC day has traded through, over the 60 retained UTC days back to the newest gap — read live, because the live range and the price decide which level qualifies — and its dist_nPocAbove composition carries the platform's shared distance sign, (price - level) / level x 100, so this one reads negative

label: Naked POC below
gloss: the nearest point of control below the price that no later UTC day has traded through, over the 60 retained UTC days back to the newest gap — read live, because the live range and the price decide which level qualifies — and its dist_nPocBelow composition carries the platform's shared distance sign, (price - level) / level x 100, so this one reads positive

label: Naked single print above
gloss: the low edge of the nearest earlier UTC day's single-print zone above the price that no later trading has touched, over the retained UTC days whose single prints were measured, back to the newest gap — read live, because the live range and the price decide which zone qualifies — and its dist_nSpAbove composition carries the platform's shared distance sign, (price - level) / level x 100, so this one reads negative

label: Naked single print below
gloss: the high edge of the nearest earlier UTC day's single-print zone below the price that no later trading has touched, over the retained UTC days whose single prints were measured, back to the newest gap — read live, because the live range and the price decide which zone qualifies — and its dist_nSpBelow composition carries the platform's shared distance sign, (price - level) / level x 100, so this one reads positive

label: New York 13–21 UTC high
gloss: the highest price of the current New York 13–21 UTC trading session so far (13:00–21:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

label: New York 13–21 UTC low
gloss: the lowest price of the current New York 13–21 UTC trading session so far (13:00–21:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session
